## W-FEED-PROBE (mobile draft 2026-09-02)

One-shot checker for the six Miniflux feeds + the Google News pattern in `miniflux-homelab.md`. The mobile sandboxes could not reach any of the hosts (egress blocked, twice), so this runs where egress is open: import, press **Run once**, read the Telegram card (or the `Classify` output table), then paste the verdicts into the verification table in `miniflux-homelab.md`. Fallback URLs are probed alongside the primaries. Delete the workflow afterwards — it is not meant to stay active.
